universe_policy: All eligible symbols from the dated reference snapshot; fixed cohort, no later IPO additions or present-day survivor filter.

signal_definitions.breakout_control: First close above prior 20-session high; same common universe and trend/liquidity gates.
signal_definitions.rs_breakout: Breakout control plus 63-session return greater than SPY, evaluated together before first-trigger detection.
signal_definitions.obv_breakout: First OBV above prior 20-session OBV high, with common trend/liquidity gates.
signal_definitions.contraction_breakout: Breakout, previous-session Bollinger width at/below its prior 120-session 20th percentile, and current volume at least 1.5 times prior 20-session average.

ranking: 63-session relative return descending, ADV20 descending, symbol ascending; shared across all arms
entry: Next observed market-session daily open proxy, only if that exact next session has a valid open; otherwise skip.
exit: After a close below 90% of entry reference, below prior 10-session low, or after 60 held sessions, sell at next available daily open; pending exits remain pending through missing prices.
cash_policy: No leverage or shorting. Fractional adjusted units. Reserve entries using preceding close NAV and cash, excluding same-day sale proceeds.
blackhorse_definition: Next-session open to the close of the 60th held session, round-trip modeled costs, >=30% net return and >=15 percentage points above matching SPY return; future-only evaluation label.
missing_prices: No forward-fill in indicators or fills. Positions carry last observed close for NAV, with stale-day counts and a final zero-value sensitivity for holdings without a final-day price.
price_basis: Vendor split-adjusted dollar turnover for liquidity and current-vintage all-adjusted OHLC/volume for signals and return proxies; no broker cash-dividend or withholding-tax ledger.
qualification: Exploratory historical fixed-cohort study. Calendar, universe and coverage audited. Renames, symbol reuse, delisting proceeds, current-vintage corporate actions, and daily-open executable fills are not fully certified. Not live qualified.
